# langsmith_sandbox_registries (Data Source)

Lists the private container image registries configured for LangSmith sandboxes.

The registry `username` and `password` are write-only and are never returned by the API, so they are not exposed by this data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every sandbox registry configured in the workspace.
data "langsmith_sandbox_registries" "all" {}

# Or narrow the list to registries whose name contains a substring.
data "langsmith_sandbox_registries" "ghcr" {
  name_contains = "ghcr"
}

output "sandbox_registry_urls" {
  value = [for r in data.langsmith_sandbox_registries.all.registries : r.url]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_contains` (String) If set, only registries whose name contains this substring are returned.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace ID to list registries from. If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `registries` (Attributes List) The sandbox registries configured in the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--registries))

<a id="nestedatt--registries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `registries`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the registry.
- `created_by` (String) The identifier of the user who created the registry.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the registry.
- `name` (String) The name of the registry. Registries are addressed by name.
- `updated_at` (String) The last modification timestamp of the registry.
- `updated_by` (String) The identifier of the user who last modified the registry.
- `url` (String) The URL of the container image registry.
